items.difficulty_reason: The lemma characterizes the stable model contraction by three properties (statement lines 6650-6666). The proof (lines 6668-6788) has two genuinely different halves: existence is a composition argument for tail and bridge contractions, and uniqueness runs a fibre-by-fibre analysis of an arbitrary competitor (fibre classification via H^1 = 0 and H^0 = kappa(y), nodality and genus 0 of 1-dimensional fibres), a rational-tail-to-point claim proved by a two-case argument against ampleness of omega_Y, and a closing Proj comparison using the projection formula on omega powers. H3: the uniqueness half alone is a research-grade chain of at least four non-formal steps.
